༄༅// rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor rnam gsal nyi ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// kun khyab chos sku spros bral nam mkha'i me long du// mi 'gyur bde chen ye shes brgya byin tshon ris gzugs// yon tan tshad med rten dang brten pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// bkrag cher snang ba bla ma 'khor lo sdom pas skyongs// lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i rang snang thar pa'i grong*// skal ba bzang po'i lus can mgron du gnyer byas par// rnam dag dbang bskur bzhi ldan cho gas rnam grol sku// rnam bzhi'i sa bon rma med 'jog de mkhas pa'i tshul// gang de grub pa'i zhal lung thabs rgyud brda don dag /shes nas bsgoms las 'byung mod sgra thos tsam gyis min// 'brug sgra ldir ba'i chu 'dzin gyis gtor char zim gyis// lo legs 'gyur gyis dbyar rnga dgod pa kho nas min// de'ang grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams khrus byas te/ phyag dang yon phul nas gral la 'khod par/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa yang theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa rnams ris su bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis las 'dir theg pa chen po ste/

ji skad du/ nyan thos theg pa 'di la ni// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad pas// theg pa chen po ga la rung*// zhes gsungs so// theg pa chen po la'ang rgyu'i theg pa dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis las khyad par du 'phags pa 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa ste/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsungs lags na// rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing*// sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i// nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs// zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas shes so// sngags kyi theg pa de la dbye ba mang du yod pa las/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa yab sras rnams kyis rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la brten nas rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa dang*/ rje 'gos kyis ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi rgyud la brten nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i skabs su rgyud sde lngar bzhed pa ni rang rang gi rgyud la brten nas skabs der rgyud sde'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa yin la/ de bzhin du/ 'dir yang rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa las/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yis// sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa// de dang de la dga' ba yi// zhes gsungs pa la brten nas mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ gsang ba'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde sgo drug tu bzhed pa las/ drug pa gsang ba'i mtha' la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang bshad pa'i rgyud gnyis las/ dang po la/ rgyud rgyas pa le'u 'bum pa/ de rtsod dus su bshad nyan ma nus pas/ de las bsdus pa shlau ka 'bum pa gsungs/ de yang rtsod dus su mi 'grub pas/

de las bsdus pa yi ge 'bum pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di gsungs zhes rje btsun gyis/ he ru ka'i byung tshul las bshad cing*/ kun spyod kyi ṭī ka dang*/ gnyan phul byung bas rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'bum phrag gsum pa bsdus pa/ le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di nyid yin par gsungs la/ kun spyod las/ nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i rgyud// 'bum gcig na yang 'di bshad de// zhes dang*/ phyag rdor stod 'grel las kyang*/ rgyud rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'bum phrag gcig yin par bshad de/ gdul bya'i blo'i bye brag gis snang tshul tsam las 'gal ba med par sems so// de ltar bshad bya rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di nyid la/ 'chad tshul rnam pa bzhi yod de/ ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bshad pa/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang mthun par bshad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par bshad pa/ gsang mtha' ltar bshad pa ste/ 'grel byed so so'i bkral tshul bzhi yod pa las/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa bshad rgyud rnam pa lngas 'chad de/ slob dpon kar rgyal zla bas/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa rin po che'i tshogs las/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang*// kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste// bshad rgyud rnam pa lnga ru 'dod// ces pa'i lnga ni/ he ru ka mngon 'byung*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ dpal sampu ṭa/ a bhi dha na rnams so// de lta bu'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud de rnams la brten 'grel byed kyi slob dpon chen po rgya gar dang bod byon pa mang pos byas pa'i 'grel bshad dpag tu med pa byung ba la brten pa'i bshad srol shin tu dar rgyas che ba byung zhing*/ khyad par deng dus bshad rgyud kyi bshad pa'i tshul rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas gsang mtha'i lugs nyid khyad par du 'phags pa bzhed pa yin no// 'dir skabs su bab pa mngon par rtogs pa'i skor la gtso bor grub chen lū nag dril gsum gyis bkral ba 'di nyid khyad par du 'phags te/

de'ang rtsa ba'i rgyud dang rnal 'byor ma kun spyod gtso bor brten nas/ lū hi pas lha sgong skyes ltar bskyed cing gtso bor sgong skyes sbyong byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa sogs mdzad/ yang rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro la brten nas grub chen nag po spyod pa pas lha mngal skyes ltar bskyed cing mngal skyes sbyong byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa sogs mdzad/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas rtsa bshad drug char gyi zab pa'i gnad thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa lha brdzus skyes ltar bskyed cing gtso bor brdzus skyes sbyong byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa sogs mdzad de/ grub chen 'di nyid kyi lus dkyil la brten pa'i gzhung gsum mdzad de/ 'di la smin par byed pa dang grol bar byed pa gnyis so// dang po ni gdul bya dbang rtul dang*/ dbang 'bring la phyi'i dkyil 'khor du rgyud smin par byas nas/ lus dkyil bsgom rung gi dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang rnon la dang po nyid nas smin byed du rung ba'i dbang du byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdzad/ gnyis pa la/ phyi rol gyi rnam rtog spangs nas/ lus dkyil 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'i bskyed rim gyi gzhung dang*/ rdzogs rim pa lnga pa'i gzhung gnyis mdzad do// slob dpon dril bu pa de nyid kyis gzhung de dag gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la rim par brgyud de thugs nyams su bzhes shing cho ga'i rim pa shin tu gsal bar mdzad pa'i phyag len gyi rim pa las byung ba ltar/ 'dir bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la gang gi bskur bar byed pa'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid mdor bsdu na/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes// cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas// snying rje'i slob ma rab 'dzin pa// dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog

/ces gsungs pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig cis kyang dgos pa yin/ gang la bskur ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul// rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan// sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba// mthun zhing grangs dang ldan par bzung*// zhes pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma nang gshin pa gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar grangs kha yar ba re phyag len du mdzad pa yin/ de ltar slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid nges par byas nas/ gang gi tshe bskur ba'i dus ni gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i yar gyi ngo'am/ de rnams lhag par 'dzom na mar ngo la yang nyes pa med par bshad la/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i gnas ni/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa/ khyad par rang ngam/ bla ma gong mas sa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du byas shing snod dang mi ldan pa skye bos dben pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa yin/ gang la brten nas bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor la mtshon par bya ba nges don don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin pa la bshad la/ de nyid mtshon par byed pa drang don kun rdzob pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub chen so sos bkral ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag mang du bshad kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ rdul tshon/ ras bris/ lus dkyil te gsum mam/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi las/ deng sang gi gang zag phal cher smin byed du rung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rdul tshon dang ras bris nyid gtso che bar gsungs pa yin/ gang zhig bskur bar dbang gi nges tshig ni/ gtor zhing blug pa ste dbang bzhi po rim pa bzhin spyi bo dang lce dang dbang gi gnas dang rlung sems la gtor zhing blugs pa la brten nas sku bzhi'i myu gu 'byung bas na dbang zhes bya ba yin/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga la lam la sbyor bar byed pa rgyu'i dbang*/

kun nas goms par byed pa lam gyi dbang*/ mi 'phrog pa la sbyor bar byed pa 'bras bu'i dbang ste/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas gsum du gsungs kyang*/ gang zag gi sgo nas du ma zhig tu 'gyur ba las/ 'dir smin byed kyi cho ga dang mthun par 'chad pa yin no// de bas na rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub pa'i bla ma brgyud pa las rim par 'ongs pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa la dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun nam brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba'i tshul gnyis las/ rdul tshon ltar na bzhi pa sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'am/ ras bris ltar na nub dang po sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la sa'i lha mo dang*/ lha dang bum pa sta gon te/ lha gnas dang po gsum kho bos bgyis zin nas/ slob ma lhag gnas la don tshan bcu bzhi las/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed// nang dbang bskur la khyad don zhu// spro ba bskyed de sdom pa gzung*// bsrung zhing byin brlabs mchod pas mchod// so shing khyor chu srung skud gdags// stan byin chos bshad rmi lam brtag /zhes pa ltar las/ rim pa ltar lus kyi bya ba ni khrus byas phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas/ rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te gus pa'i sgo nas/ slob dpon dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/ slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po// theg chen blo can rnams la ni// de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa yi// yang dag cho ga rjes su gnang*// kha cig gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer// dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par 'gyur// de bzhin gzhan ni bsod nams 'dod// gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gzhol// blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer 'jug

/'jig rten 'di 'bras dor nas ni// 'jig rten pha rol 'bras gnyer na// gang phyir tshe 'di bde blag 'grub// 'di yis 'jig rten pha rol min// de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi// don du yid ni brtan par gyis// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni rang rang gi sdom pa thob pa'i bslab pa dang ldan pa'i 'khor bzhi po theg chen gyi blo dang ldan pa'i/ sngags kyi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes don du gnyer ba dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya yi/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang*/ rang don du nyan rang gi byang chub 'dod pa rnams ni ma yin te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la ma ltos par thabs dman pa gzhan la brten nas bsgrub tu yod pa'i phyir ro// de bas na bdag gzhan thams cad srid zhi'i pha rol tu son nas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i dad pa dang blo gros dang ldan pa bdag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras don du gnyer bas zhugs na pha rol gyi don mi 'grub cing*/ gzhan don du mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas la dmigs te zhugs na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa yin/ de ltar nges par byas nas bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ de rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod na/ dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig za ba dang*/ gsod pa dang bkol spyad kyi sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal gyis ma rnyed pa dang*/ mi 'dod pa thog tu bab pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang*/ lus bcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha rnams la 'chi 'pho dang gong ma nas 'og mar ltung ba dang*/

mthar ngan song du skye bar shes pas na dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las kyang ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal rnams yod par bshad/ 'o na sdug bsngal de dag las rang nyid gcig pu thar pa'i nyan rang gi byang chub thob par bya dgos pa yin nam snyam na/ nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs shing gzhan don gyi phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung*/ mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du byed pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya yin na/ shes rab chen po'i 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'das shing*/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'ang rang nyid gcig pu'i don du ma yin te/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re res kyang bdag gi pha ma byas shing*/ byas res kyi gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin chen sha stag yin pa la/ 'di rnams 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis ni ldong*/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang ni bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bu bas ni ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam nas rdeg 'chos shing*/ ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar 'grim pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du mos pa mdzod/ snying rje'o byas nas bzhag pas mi phan pas/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral bde ba la dgod dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag pas lhag pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa la'ang med/

su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas/ bdag gis ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de'ang rgyu med rkyen med las mi thob pas rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par blangs te/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyi zhing lam la ci nus kyi 'bad pa bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed 'tshal/ bsam pa de lta bus kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung gi tshul gyis 'grub pa yin te/ dper na 'bras lo legs na rtswa dang phub ma zhar las 'byung ba dang 'dra'o// nang gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rnams slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis slar yang sbyangs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i padmar babs pas khyed rnams skad cig gis he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can re rer gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i padmar bab pa khyed rnams he ru kar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rnams he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis yum gyi sku g.yon pa nas 'thon te rang rang gi gral la 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de ltar byed pa'i dgos pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi ma thob bar gyi gsang ba'i chos rnams nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba dang*/ de dag gi skabs su slob dpon la yang gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ched du bsgrub pa lags/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba ni slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa stsal du gsol snyam pas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma dang zhal sbyor bzhugs// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa'i rgyal// byang chub chen po'i tshul sogs nas// thar pa chen po'i pho brang du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab ste/ de'i don ni/ slob dpon la dga' chen zhes bos nas/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshal ba'i slad du dam tshig ste sngags kyi sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa stsal ba'i sgo nas thar pa chen po'i sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du gzhug tu gsol zhes pa'i don to// de ltar khyad par can gyi lam rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no zhes shes pa'i ched du spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni// ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// gang gi shākya seng ge sogs// mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde// mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen 'thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas bur byas zin pa de la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te/ khyed rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa de khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje'i theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing*/ khyad par du yang 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas su zin yang 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'dzam bu gling du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ rtag par zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa yin no// de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ba yin pas kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po thob pa'i phyir chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba gyis shig ces pa'i don to// rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thib pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/

'khor 'das kun du dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar bstan pa'i don dam pa byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba ste don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs nas/ 'grub par shog ces pas rgyun bshags lan gsum byas pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing thob pa yar 'phel du byed pa yin te/ de dag ni slob ma'i rigs can la thun mong gi sdom pa sbyin pa yin/ slar yang slob dpon gyi rigs can la rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ khyed rnams phyag thal mo sbyar te/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni// 'khor lo'i lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gi /sdom pa gsang ba bla med par// rtag tu sems can kun don phyir// slob dpon du 'gyur bdag la gsungs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/

slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la phyogs te rdor dril bzung nas/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams ni// byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing*// dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi// 'khor lo 'di yang 'jug par 'tshal// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni// bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam// zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni rab tu de 'tshal lo// zhes lan btab nas slob dpon gyis khyed rnams la sdom pa bsgrags pa 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ sangs rgyas rdo rje rin po che// padma las kyi rigs mchog gi /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du so sor gzung*// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yang*// phas pham bzhi dang mi dge bcu// rnam par 'phrul ba'i chang 'thung ba// de dag kun du spang bar gyis// sems can don min bya min spongs// dam pa nyer bsten rnal 'byor kun// theg pa dman la 'dod mi byed// sdom brtson khyod kyis bsrung bar gyis// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni sangs rgyas te rnam snang gi dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa yin te/ rnam snang sangs rgyas kyi sku yin pas yon tan gyi rten byed pa ltar/ skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom pas kyang sdom pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i phyir ro// rdo rje ste mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i rdo rje dril bu/ phyag rgya slob dpon rnams 'dzin pa ste mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo yin pa ltar/ dam tshig gsum dang slob dpon yang byang chub kyi sems kyis 'dzin pas so// rin chen te rin 'byung gi dam tshig ni/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams pa'i sbyin pa rnams nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug tu gtong ba'am/

dngos su mi nus na 'dun pa dang ma bral bar bya ba ste/ rin 'byung sbyin pa'i ngo bo ser sna rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ sbyin pa yang dbul ba 'dor bar byed pa dang ser sna'i gnyen po yin pas so// padma ste 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig ni/ phyi bya spyod/ nang rnal 'byor/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhi dang*/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpa' ste theg pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin par dam 'cha' ba ste 'od dpag med shes rab kyi ngo bo gsung rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ chos kyang shes rab kyis 'dzin cing gsung gis ston pas so// las kyi rigs te don yod grub pa'i dam tshig ni/ sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya ba yin te/ don yod grub pa brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo phrin las kyi rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ dge ba la spro ba'i brtson 'grus kyi sdom pa 'dzin pa dang sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed pa gnyis ka sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rjes su skyong ba yin pas so// de rnams kyi rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bsgrags nas/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig bsgrags pa la tshul khrims gsum spyir bshad pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las bshad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po la 'byung ba'i ltung ba gcig blon po la 'byung ba gcig rgyal blon la thun mong du 'byung ba bzhi/ byang sems las dang po pa la 'byung ba brgyad de bcu bzhi po 'di yang bsrung dgos par ston pa la/ nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te tshul khrims gsum bsrung bar ston pa dang*/ so thar byang sems gnyis su ma zad gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs rgyud sde 'og ma nas bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung dgos par ston pa ste/ rgyud sde gong ma'i sdom pa'i nang du 'og ma'i sdom pa'ang 'du bas so// de ltar bshad pa'i don de dag yid la dran pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/
sras bcas

'di la shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'i dbang chog tu/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs nas/ sdom pa dag kyang ma lus gzung*// zhes pa'i bar shlau ka bcu bdun tsam yod pa'i rjes zlos bya bar bshad kyang*/ 'di brjod pa zor yang ba'i ched du mkhas pa gzhan gyi gzhung du bshad pa ltar phyag len bde ba'i ched dang*/ slob mas kyang brda 'phrod sla ba'i ched du 'di ltar byas pa yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang nas/ mya ngan 'das la 'god ces pas sdom pa gzung ngo*// de ltar sdom pa bzung ba de bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis zhal bzhi pa'i sngags tshar gcig brjod de bsrung nas byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rnams kyi snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su mas rim gyis reg cing hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas snying ga hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i āḥ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ rnams gsal lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slar yang yas rim gyis reg cing oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas yig 'bru rnams las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams spyan drangs nas yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsam/ slar yang mas rim gyis reg cing hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed par bsam mo// de ltar khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa de mchod yul du bzang ba yin pas me tog dbu la phul nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ bdug spos shangs la/ dhū pe/ mar me spyan lam du/ ā lo ke dri'i byug pa thugs kar/

gandhe/ zhal zas ljags la/ nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa ni sgo gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrungs nas lhar bskyed cing mchod nas/ mthun rkyen dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i thog mar so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/ yum gyi snying po'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa khaṇḍa ro has bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gi cod paṇa dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du sbyin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥdzī hwa badzra saṃ wardha ni swā hā/ zhes pas byin pa'i so shing de rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te so drud pa bzhin byas pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas brgyud de khongs par song bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos te/ ltos pa med par thal mo kha phye ste/ so shing gi rwa ba khru gang gru bzhi dri bzang gis byugs pa la tshom bu dgu bkod par dor te/ rtse mo bdag nyid la phyogs na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su bum pa bzang po la sogs pa dngos grub phran tshegs 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ni rnal 'byor chen po'i bum dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ so shing gis so dang kha la sogs pa lus gtso che ba'i dri ma sbyang ba bzhin bum dbang gis kyang gtso bor lus kyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa lags/

rmi lam gsal po 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu blud pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung zhing hūm̐ bzlas pa'i khyor chu/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nishtsa sya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas lan gsum re byin la/ de ni gsang dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ khyor chus ngag gi dri ma sbyong ba bzhin/ gsang dbang gis kyang ngag gi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa'o// rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du srung skud sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ bzla zhing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa'i srad bu gong ltar bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa rdo rje slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig gi srad bu la thim zhes dang*/ srung skud thal mo'i bar du bzung la yab yum gyi snying po yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ buddha mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarbāṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i srung skud de skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas su nyis skor du bcings/ las bum gyi chus gtor zhing*/ khaṇḍa ro ha dang*/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis kyang bsrung ba yang bshad do// de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ srung skud 'dogs pa shes rab ye shes kyi sbyang gzhi khams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir du yin pa bzhin shes rab ye shes kyang khams bdud rtsi la bskur ba yin/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir du ku sha sbyin pa ni/

ku sha'i phon po che chung gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dang dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas dhīḥbazlas pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas kyi don du phyag g.yas dang*/ ha bzlas pa'i che ba stan gyi don du g.yon par byin te/ de'i don ku sha ni 'dag byed kyi rdzas bla na med pa yin pa ltar/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyis kyang mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'dag par byed pas ku sha sbyin pa dbang bzhi pa'i sngon 'gro ste/ sngon byung bcom ldan 'das ku sha mi 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin du khyed rnams kyang ku sha'i stan la nyal te rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa'i don to// chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dum wā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas dkon te/ sangs rgyas zhig 'jig rten du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na/ de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu u dum wā ra'i me tog gcig 'byung la/ de yang rgyal rigs las 'byung na me tog dkar po dang*/ bram ze'i rigs las 'byung na ser po 'byung la/ sangs rgyas de lhums su zhugs pa na me tog de kha 'bus/ bltams pa na kha bye/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na cung zad rnying*/ 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa na rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa na skam nas 'gro ste/ des na de gnyis dkon mtshungs yin pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ byon nas chos gsungs pa dkon/

chos kyi nang nas theg pa chen po gsungs pa dkon/ theg chen gyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung ba shin tu dkon no// dkon pas ci phan ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang dkon no snyam na/ de dag dang mi mtshungs par dkon yang phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ bskal pa bye ba du ma nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba'i mod la 'dag par 'gyur na/ dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan du byas nas sngags kyi spyod pa yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs nyams su len pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la brtson pa'i sgo nas lam 'di la blo brtan par byas na ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyun gcod par 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ de bas na khyed rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed kyis/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas yongs su bzung ste de'i rigs su skye bzhin par gyur pas na/ theg chen gyi lam mchog tu gyur pa 'di la brten nas myur du 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas don de la dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par mdzod cig ces 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed nas/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun nga la drang por smros// zhes bshad pas rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i mal zhig bcas te slob dpon gyis byin pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che ba stan du btings/ gos dri ma med pa gyon/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyi nyal te/ sems dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thag ring du byas/ lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas/ sang nyin yi dam gyi lha'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas dran shes bzhin dang ldan par nyal na lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur te/

de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin// mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong*// de la mchod pa brtsam pa dang*// dge slong dag las chos nyan nam// yang na mi nyan na yang rung*// chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang*// de bzhin mdo sde rnam par spyod// ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang*/ mchod rten mthong ba dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam lag tu thogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su zhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma la chos nyan pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang po zhon pa/ nyi phug tu nyi ma lde ba/ dge slong dag dang chos kyi 'bel gtam byed pa/ zas bzang po ro brgya dang ldan pa thob pa/ 'bru'am bang mdzod la sogs pa'i gter rnyed pa/ skye bo mang pos bdag la 'dud bstod byed pa/ skye bo mang po la bdag nyid kyis chos bshad pa/ pha ma dang bla ma dang mdza' bshes dang 'phrad pa/ gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa la sogs pa rmi na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gang rung 'grub par shes par byas nas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te ngan pa'ang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mo dang ma he la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ g.yang sa dang gcong rong du zhugs pa/ ri dang shing las lhung ba/ khyi dang khwa dang srin pos zos pa/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyug pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ skra bregs pa/ lus til mar gyis byugs pa/ phreng ba dmar pos thod bcings pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas/ gnyis sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de/

don la grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang ba'i rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin lung blangs te nyams su len pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blug pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin/ de rnams kyi slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin nas dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs kyis dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ sta gon byas pa'i slob ma rnams gral rim bzhin 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas nas/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang shin tu zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun du spyod pa yang rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rang re rnams kyi rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re byed dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan don dam par sems can thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na yang*/ gnas skabs blo bur gyi dri ma sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal gyi 'khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing*/

'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa yin te/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams kyi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med pas 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag pa'i slad du tshe 'di'i bya ba snying po med pa thams cad spangs te/ 'dir shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po dang rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum blangs la dam tshig la bsrung bsdam dang*/ lam la'ang ci nus kyi sgo nas 'bad par bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed mdzod/ de la sta gon du gnas pa yan chad grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ cho ga bgo ba'i tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa ste rnam pa bzhis bsgrubs nas/ nang du dkyil 'khor pa mchod pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor mas tshim par bya ba rnams dgos te/

de dag legs par grub pa byas pa yin/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang rnams rang rgyud kyi dam tshig gso ba'i blos bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis len pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dam tshig gi glu blang zhing bden pa bsgrags pa dang*/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul dgos pa rnams grub zin nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis yod pa las/ dang po 'jug pa la/ maṇḍal 'bul dang gsol ba gdab// mig ras me tog gtad cing bsang*// dris lan byas te rgyun bshags bya// nang gi sems bskyed gsang bar gdams// nang 'jug phyag 'tshal dam la bzhag /gsol gdab ye shes dbab brtan bya// lha la gsol gdab kha dog brtag /me tog dor dang mig ras bsal// lha ngo bstan pa 'jug pa'o// zhes pa ltar las/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa gling bzhi ri rab lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam par sprul te phul bar mos te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku sogs nas/ de nyid grub par mdzod ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can re rer gyur par mos pa mdzod/ sngon chad 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/

zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du slob dpon gyis sumbha sogs zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mig dar ser po'am dmar po res gdong g.yogs byin te/ oṃ tsakṣu nas hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcings nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten gyi slad du u dum wā ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re yang byin par mos/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas byin nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khaṇḍa ro ha'i tshogs sogs nas bskrad par mos te/ las bum gyi chus gtor zhing oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal bar mos pa mdzod/ de nas rigs nges pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin zhes dris pa la lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang la'o// yang slob dpon gyis/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes pas rigs nges par byas/ gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems sogs nas rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa re gsal btab nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba nas mi zhes thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de nyid/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi snying gar me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhag ste/ oṃ su ra ti nas su khaṃ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas/ de ltar sems bskyed pa de dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun du spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ deng khyod sogs nas mi bya'o zhes pa rnams ni phyi'i 'jug pa'o// nang 'jug gi slad du khyed rnams dkyil 'khor las spros pa'i khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i sgo ma rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khrid par mos la/

dngos su ni slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing lus cung zad dud par byos shig de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pa la/ lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ dpral bar thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ na ma te hūm̐/ mgrin par sbyar te na ma mi hūm̐/ snying gar sbyar te na mo na ma hūm̐ swā hā zhes pas phyag byas/ yang gnas de nyid nas thal mo spyi bor sbyar la mkha' 'gro ma la bdag la byin gyis rlobs shig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba wi ra sogs nas tiṣṭhantu māṃ zhes dang*/ yang 'dod snam gyi steng nas g.yon skor gyi byang sgor phyin nas thal mo snying gar sbyar la lā ma la bdag la dbang bskur cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba bī ra sogs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du nub sgo nas thal mo dpral bar sbyar te khaṇḍa ro hā la chos ston par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba nas pra warta ya māṃ zhes dang*/ de nas lho sgor phyin la thal mo spyi gtsug tu sbyar te gzugs can ma la phrin las bzhi gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba sogs nas karma kurbantu māṃ zhes dang*/ slar yang shar sgor phyin nas 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams gsang ba chen po yongs su 'dzin par spro'am zhes dri ba ni/ dus gsum sogs nas khyod 'dod dam zhes dris pa la lan btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni rab tu 'tshal lags so zhes lan btab/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thib ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas/

de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun gyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis nye bar bstan pa'i don dam pa byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid kyi bdag nyid can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba ste/ don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs nas/ 'grub par shog ces pas rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ slar yang de dag gi spyan sngar rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyis bsdus pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs nas 'das la 'god ces pa dam tshig bzung ba khas blangs nas/ de las mi 'da' ba'i phyir dam la bzhag pa bzhi las/ thog mar phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi lag pa nas bzung ste deng khyod nas brjod par mi bya'o zhes dang*/

nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'i slad du khyed rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag cing dril bu dkrol ba dang bcas te/ 'di ni nas 'gas par byed do zhes dang*/ phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'i phyir snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ oṃ he ru ka nas dral te gshegs/ mna' chu blud pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ dri bzang gi chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa byin te/ 'di ni nas ṭha ṭha zhes dang*/ bla ma'i bka' mnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'i slad du spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te nas 'gyur ta re zhes pa ste dam bzhag bzhi song nas/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i sngon du maṇḍal 'bul ba 'dir ma bshad kyang*/ phyag len la kha bskang bar mdzad pas ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs nas gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams dngos po dang mtshan ma gang la'ang ma zhen par phyi nang gi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin du shes par byas la/ de'i ngang las khyed rnams 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis sogs nas rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzheṃ dmar po drag cing bzod par dka' ba rnams gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la mos gus drag tu byas pas de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sogs nas bde mchog lha lnga'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas mtsho la kha ba bab pa ltar sib kyis thim pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ de'i tshe las kyi rdo rjes zla mtshan dang ldan pa'i bud med kyi mdoms dkris kyi ras dang byi la nag po'i brun/

bdud rtsi lnga rnams gu gul dang bsres te zhib mor btags pa ro sol gyi me la bsregs pas bdug cing*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje khrag 'thung drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol ba dang bcas te/ yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i sngags kyi mjug tu ā we sha ya sogs brjod pas dbab/ de ltar byas pas sku bab na nam mkha' la 'phar ba dang*/ gsung bab na dge ba dang mi dge ba la sogs pa lung ston pa dang*/ thugs bab na 'jig rten gsum mngon par shes pa sogs 'byung la/ gal te gsung bab pa las smra bar ma 'dod na/ slob ma de gos dkar mor dmigs la de'i lce la yi ge a dmar po bkod de/ bru hi badzra zhes bya ba'am/ oṃ mgon po chen po rdo rje chos// 'od dpag med pa bde ba che// 'dod chags chen pos chos gsungs shig /dge dang mi dge gang yin smros// zhes brjod pas lung ston par 'gyur ro// yang sku bab pas 'phar tshabs shin tu che na/ de'i mgo bo'i steng du laṃ las byung ba'i gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi shin tu ljid pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan par bsams na mi g.yo bar 'gyur ro// gang ltar yang rung ste ye shes phebs pa brtan par bya ba'i phyir khyed rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes pas brtan par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor du slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba btab cing bden pa'i byin gyis brlab pa bya ba slob dpon gyis bgyi ste/ de'ang 'di ltar slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa nas de bzhin shog ces bya ba lan gsum brjod/ de nas dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ khyed rnams spyan spyan ras dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang la bltas pas kha dog gi bye brag gang snang ba nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam la ci snang zhes dri/

des kyang dkar po la sogs pa ji ltar snang ba bzhin smra bar bya'o// de'ang dkar pos zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang*/ sngon pos drag shul/ sna tshogs mthong na phrin las thams cad 'grub ces lung bstan no// dkyil 'khor la me tog dor ba ni/ sngar gyi me tog de traṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog du gyur ces byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di na dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gtso 'khor tha dad kyi rnam par snang yang*/ don la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes gcig nyid du ma'i rnam par snang ba ma gtogs/ bzang ngan gyi khyad par cung zad kyang med mod/ rang rang gi rang rigs kyi lha gang yin pa zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam pas ltos pa med par/ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥzhes gsung zhing dor cig ces 'dor du gzhug go /de la me tog lhung ba'i bye brag gis rigs kyi lha gang yin pa dang*/ dngos grub 'grub pa'i bye brag rtogs par bya ste/ de'ang rdul tshon du sku gzugs dngos bzhag pa'am/ ras bris lta bu yin na lha'i mdzod spu'am/ gtsug tor ram/ dbu la lhung na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub/ spyan nam zhal la lhung na sngags kyi dngos grub 'grub/ sku stod la dngos grub mchog rked pa la 'bring*/ sku smad la tha ma/ sku gzugs dang nye na dngos grub myur/ shin tu ring na dngos grub ring*/ lha gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de'i rigs dang dngos grub 'grub/ mnyam na rang gang mos pa de'i rigs yin no// gal te rtsig pa'i phyi rol du lhung na lan gsum bar du bskyar/ de ltar byas kyang der lhung na dngos grub phra mo tsam las mi 'grub cing*/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du lhung na skal ba med pa yin pas gzung bar mi bya'o zhes kyang bshad do// me tog de nyid gang la phog pa'i lhas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bcing ba'i mos pa dang bcas te slob dpon gyi me tog blangs pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/

pra ti gṛhṇa sogs brjod de spyi bor bzhag khyed rnams kyi mig gnyis su oṃ yig 'bar ba re dang snying gar hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ re gsal thob mdzod la/ hūm̐ gi bskul bas raṃ gyi mes sgrib pa bsregs/ oṃ gyi 'od kyis gsal bar byas nas/ ma rig pa'i ling thog dang mig ras lhan cig bsal te/ he ru ka dpal sogs nas hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gdong g.yogs bsal te/ dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul ba ni/ oṃ dkyil 'khor nas brtson par gyis zhes blta bar bskul nas/ gang la blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'di na dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bzhugs te/ de'ang phyi rol rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ drwa ba gur bla re/ phyi rol du mda'i drwa ba dang ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du chud pa'i 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ sna tshogs padma'i lte bar sna tshogs rdo rje chen po shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs dkyus ltar brjod pa'am/ bsdu na rta babs bzhis mdzes shing*/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du pha gu dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ mda' yab dang*/ pu shu rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa zhes pa tsam gyis thus/ de'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i grwa bzhir dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud la gri gug gi rwa bas bskor ba'i lte bar 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan brtsegs pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i gdan/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ro'i snying gar zla ba'i gdan/

mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la zla ba'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro hā dmar po/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig sogs nas g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa ste bzhis bskor ba'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog ind+ra nī la sogs nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa dang bcas pa ni brten pa lha ste/ mdor na rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams gdos bcas kyi rnam pa'am/ tsa ka lir bris pa lta bu ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mjal snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de dag ni lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga yin no// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang bskur ba la/ rang don phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ yon dbul gsol gdab dbang stegs gzhag /byur bsal shis brjod dbang lnga bskur// bzlas lung sbyin gzung slob ma'i dbang*// zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar rdo rje slob ma'i dbang rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ji ltar sangs rgyas nas stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor sogs nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi nga rgyal gyis 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ de la byur bsal ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying ga nas sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas sna sgor thon/

sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa de nyid mdun gyi til lam yungs kar la thim pa de la hūm̐ bzhi bzla zhing*/ yungs kar de slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rje'i lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung la khyed rnams la g.yas pas g.yas su/ g.yon pas g.yon du/ gnyis kas g.yas su bskor zhing me chur dor la/ oṃ sarba sogs nas swā hā zhes lan gsum/ slar yang dri chab kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ shrī badzra he he sogs brjod/ bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang hūm̐ bzla zhing sardza ra dza'i spos kyis bdug par bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha sogs nas sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs te/ dbang gi lha'i mdun gyi nam mkha'i ltos thams cad khyab par bzhugs te/ de rnams kyi gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs nas slob dpon dang bcas pas bkra shis kyi cho ga byas par bsams la/ las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal bum pa btig slob dpon gyis rdor dril 'dzin pas me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te/ phun sum tshogs pa nas bkra shis dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig ces pa de rnams kyis sbyor ba'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la 'di ltar nges pa bya ste/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa sogs nas 'di rnams la go ba rnyed pa gal che zhes pa'i bar gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sogs kyi brda skrod rnams spro na/ kye rdo rje'i dbang bshad lung rigs man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa ltar brjod kyang legs/ gal te ma brjod kyang 'gal ba med la gang ltar yang rig pa'i dbang lnga'i thog mar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chu dang khaṇḍa ro has bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/

gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa he ru ka sku mdog sngon po sogs nas mnyam par sbyor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa de la slob dpon gyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas khyed rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas dbang rdzas la thim/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu kha rgyan gyis dbang rdzas la 'thor ba dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis dbang rdzas la dbang bskur bas dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ sngar slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga rig ma/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo bcas pa'i dbang gi lha dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa de rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can gyi nas gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo khro mos bgegs bskrad/ rig ma rnams kyis bum pa dkar po byang chub kyi sems kyis chus gang bas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod ces brjod la/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las khyed rnams kyi spyi bor mi bskyod pa re res dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang lha gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon pa khyed rnams kyi lus la thim par mos pa mdzod/

de ltar khyed rnams mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa de la nam mkhar gnas pa'i me tog ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyi nye bar spyod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs brjod/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas sogs kyis rtogs bskyed bya/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang la slob ma dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du traṃ las rin po che traṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka sogs kyis bskyed la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur pa bltas te/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rin chen can gyi sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rin 'byung gi rang bzhin can gyi dbu rgyan thogs te khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bcings te/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang*/ de brtan pa'i slad du oṃ badzrī bha wa sogs kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing lud pa las rna ltag g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbur brgyan/ dbang lha las rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang lha bstims nas mchod de rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas sogs rtogs bskyed bya/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang so so'i dbang rdzas sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs sgos chos kyi khyad par ma gtogs des 'gre'o// 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang la slob ma dang dbang rdzas rdo rje bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du aṃ las padma aṃ gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med he ru ka bskyed nas/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bltas la/

nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ padma can gyi sogs brjod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha dang slob dpon lhan cig pas 'od dpag med pa'i rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje thogs te/ khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg la lag pa g.yas par gtad de dbang bskur bar mos/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing lag tu gtad/ sngar bzhin chu dbang bskur la ltag par 'od dpag med kyi dbur brgyan/ dbang lha las 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa slob mar bstims la mchod de/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sogs rtogs bskyed bya/ don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang la khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas dril bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma'i steng du khaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje khaṃ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa he ru ka bskyed la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bltas la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sna tshogs can gyi sangs rgyas la sogs brjod/ dbang lha dang slob dpon lhan cig pas don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dril bu phyag g.yon par gtad de/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs nas karma a bhi ṣe ka sogs brjod cing dbang bskur te/ de nas khyed rnams kyi lag pa gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i pad skor sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud pa'i tshul gyi phyag rgya gyis shig sngar bzhin chu dbang bskur te lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las khyed rnams kyi rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pas dbur brgyan te/ dbang lha las don yod grub pa gtso bor gyur pa slob mar bstims la mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sogs kyi rtogs bskyed bya/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang la khyed rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka yab yum bskyed/

gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug 'dir dbang rdzas lha bskyed pa med pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'khor lo can gyi sogs brjod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin can gyi ming gis dbang bskur ba'i phyir du slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang dril bu lhan cig bzung bar khyed rnams kyi spyi bor dkrol zhing*/ dbang bskur sogs nas che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa la'o zhes dang*/ buddha a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod cing*/ ming de yang me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs dang rjes su 'brel par gdags te/ de'ang gtso bo la phog na kye dpal mi bskyod rdo rje'am zhe sdang rdo rje zhes pa lta bu dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la gti mug rdo rje/ lā ma la phrag dog rdo rje/ dum skyes ma la 'dod chags rdo rje/ gzugs can ma la phog na nga rgyal rdo rje zhes bya ba sogs gdags/ de bzhin du bud med la mā ma kī la sogs pa'i ming btags te dbye ba rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o// chu de brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur/ lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las mtshog mar rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbur brgyan pa la dbang lha rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa bstims la mchod de/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad sogs kyi rtogs bskyed bya'o// de lta bu'i dbang lnga po de dag ni spang bya ma rig pa sogs nyon mongs pa lnga spangs shing gnyen po rig pa ye shes lnga bskyed par byed pas sam/ thams cad du spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig pa'i lha mo'i dbang bskur bar byed pa'i phyir rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ste/ dbang de thob pas bya spyod kyi rgyud man chad nyan pa dang 'chad pa dang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ba'i slob dpon du gyur pa yin no// de nas me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i sgrub thabs dang*/

de'i sngags kyi bzlas lung dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs rnams sbyin par bya ba yin la/ 'dir ni thun mong du/ sngags kyi bzlas lung 'di tsam zhig bya ste/ de'ang slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge hūm̐ de'i mthar yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal btab/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis chad pa'i tshul gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas byung zhal nas 'thon khyed rnams kyi rna ba g.yas nas zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod par mos la me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ shrī badzra he he sogs brjod/ de nas slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags sogs brjod do// des sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin no// gnyis pa gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la thog mar maṇḍal phul la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kye ho nas stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gong du bshad pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng du padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las khyed rnams rdo rje 'chang sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gyis bskyed la/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te sogs nas sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sogs dang thog mtha' med pa'i sogs nas ma hā badzra hūm̐ zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni rdo rje 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba chos kyi dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/

rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te sogs nas badzra ghaṇḍe aḥzhes dang*/ de'i don ni dril bu 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba skye 'gag gnas gnas gsum gyi stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa nges don gyi dril bu yin no// phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig gi slad du khyed rnams kyi pang du ye shes kyi phyag rgya yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can re gtad par mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje che dang nas nyid du gyis zhes brjod cing de la 'khyud pa'i tshul re byos shig yid kyi lus ni nas sogs rab tu bsgrags zhes brjod/ de'i don ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba bde stong gnyis su med pa'i lha sku sgyu ma lta bu zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can yin la/ de dang rang gi lus tha dad med pa yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de brtan pa'i slad du nam mkhar khyab pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad sogs sngar chu dbang gi skabs su bshad pa ltar brjod cing bsams la/ dbang bskur rdo rje zhes sogs kyi mthar/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las khyed rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad khyed rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang du rab tu gnas par byas pa mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha sogs me tog 'thor/

de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i me tog ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mnga' dbul gyi tshul du mchod pa rgyas pas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod nas/ de nyid lnga pas bstod do// de dag ni phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yin no// de ltar rdo rje slob dpon du dbang thob pa'i slob ma la/ ji skad du/ dbang bskur nas ni de nyid bshad// ces 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid bstan dgos pas/ de'ang tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ mi mnyam med pa sogs nas snying po 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor yin zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ de'i don ni gzhal yas khang yan lag dang bcas pa ni/ lam dang 'bras bu'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa yin no// lha'i de kho na nyid ni yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs nas gzugs can ma'o zhes pa'i bar gyi rnam dag ni go sla bar nyid de/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba yin no zhes pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid do// mtha' brten rjes su gnang ba la drug las/ thog mar lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni sgeg sogs brgyad kyi phyag rgya rnams slob dpon la gzigs te 'ching zhing gsan par 'tshal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs nas gaḥ deng phyin chad lus kyi sgo nas sgeg pa dang*/ ngag gi sgo nas glu len pa la sogs pa spyod lam ci byed pa thams cad mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan ma yin par lha mchod pa'i bsams pas zin par gyis shig sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ni mig thur ram rdo rje thogs te/ praṃ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma'i rang bzhin can gyi thur ma'am/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes khyed rnams kyi mig gi thad kar byug pa ltar byas pas ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas/ sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan pa bya snyam du mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar mig mkhan sogs nas/ laṃ hrīḥzhes pas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas nas/ chos kyi mig dri ma dang bral ba thob pa des/ chos can gyi snang ba thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar nges pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du/ a las byung ba'i me long bstan te chos rnams gzugs brnyan sogs nas sras su skye zhes pas me long gi rjes gnang byin nas/ de ltar kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las du mar snang yang dril bu'i sgra khog pa dang lce dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba gsum gang las byung dpyad na mi rnyed pa rang bzhin gyis stong pa ltar/ chos nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can du shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du dbyangs tha ma las skyes pa'i dril bu byin te/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid sogs nas nyid du gsal/ zhes pas chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan yang thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang bral na nyan rang gi sar ltung bar 'gyur bas rang don yid la byed pa'i bsam pa bcom dgos so zhes shes pa'i slad du/ hoḥlas skyes pa'i rdo rje chags pa'i ngo bo mda' gzhu/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas byos shig ces pas byin te/ thabs kyi mda' drug shes rab kyi gzhu la bkang nas phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis te drug tu 'phangs pas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom par mos la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o zhes gsungs shig chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ bhrūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo oṃ badzra he tu māṃ zhes pas zhabs kyi 'og tu 'khor lo byin te/ sems can 'khor ba las drongs shig ces pa'i don yin/

'dren lugs ji ltar byed na a las byung ba'i dung badzra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas phyag g.yas su byin te/ dung bus la sems can 'khor du bsdus shig ces pa'i don yin/ tshul ji ltar na dbyangs tha ma las skyes pa'i dril bu oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe aḥzhes pas phyag g.yon par dril bu byin te chos kyi sgra sgrogs shig ces pa'i don yin/ chos gang gis na a zhes pas rgyud kyi glegs bam byin te chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin pas/ de ltar nges pa'i sgo nas dung 'bud pa dang dril bu 'khrol ba dang glegs bam klog pa'i tshul mdzod cig deng nas brtsams te sogs nas srung bar mdzad ces pas spyir btang chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang byin nas/ chos bshad pa de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i chos bstan dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya rnams slob dpon la gzigs nas mdzad par zhu/ sems can sogs nas bshad pa gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ de dag gis chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba rnams song nas/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang las/ phrin las sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ zhi dang sogs nas sgrub par gyis zhes pa ste/ zhi sogs dman pa bzhi dang grub chen brgyad de/ de'ang thun mong gi dngos grub ral gri khar bcug nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ mig la mig sman byugs nas 'jig rten gsum mthong ba dang*/ sa 'og gi gter bum bton nas sems can rnams la ci 'dod pa ster ba dang*/ rkang pa la rdzas byugs nas rkang mgyogs dang*/ ril bu khar bcug nas sus kyang mi mthong zhing gnod sbyin ltar 'dod pa'i gzugs bsgyur ba dang*/ thig le dpral bar byas nas bdag sus kyang mi mthong ba dang*/ tshe nyi zla ltar gnas pa dang*/ lus lo bcu drug lon pa 'dra ba dang*/

lcags zangs gser du bsgyur ba dang*/ gsum po de la bcud len zhes gsungs te tshe dang lus dang longs spyod kyi bcud len dang*/ bu mo dam pa dgug pa ni gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i sgo nas te/ de dag sgrub pa'i sgo nas kyang rang gzhan la phan 'dogs par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin no// brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang la gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni khyed rnams rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas hi hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing*/ khyed rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par rdo rje byin pa de nyid smin mtshams kyi bar du lan gsum gsor te/ 'gying ba dang bcas te snying gar zung zhig deng phyin chad sogs nas gyis shig ces bsgo/ thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs kyi don du khyed rang rnams skad cig gi pad nyi'i steng du 'khor lo bde mchog yum dang bcas pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la sems can gyi don byed pa'i spyod pa mthu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir du lag pa g.yas su ḍā ma ru/ g.yon du thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ gru mo g.yon par kha ṭwāṃ ga tshangs skud se ral khar bcings te kha ṭwāṃ ga ni sogs nas blang bar gyis/ de dag gi don yang kha ṭwāṃ ga ni lha sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ thod pa ni bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ de dag dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces brjod ḍā ma ru dkrol tshul dang*/ bdud rtsi myang ngo*// lung bstan pa ni/ lung phal cher sprul pa'i sku rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa can gyis lung ston srid pas/ skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du 'phos nas lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gos kyi grwa gnyis snying gar bzung*/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya khyed rnams kyi spyi bor gtugs te/

me tog gang la phog pa'i lha las gras pa'i ming nas lung ston par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ 'dir ni sogs nas dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes thams cad rdzogs pa dang*/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sarba ta thā ga ta sogs nas sngags 'dis stobs yin no zhes ji ltar lung bstan pa de ltar du 'gyur nges snyam pa'i dga' ba bsgom mdzod/ zhes lung bstan nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ tshig 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ da ni khyod nyid nas sngags la sbyor/ zhes brjod de/ de'i don ni khyed rnams sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen por sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthun par gsung zhing*/ bu sdug pa ltar yongs su dgongs pa'i phyir/ deng phyin chad khyed rnams rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas/ de'i las su bya ba dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la sogs pa tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig pa'i don to// gzengs bstod pa ni mchog tu gsang ba nas ma 'jigs shig ces pa ste/ de'i don ni khyed rnams snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs shing mthong ba la brten nas/ sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad las 'das te bde ba chen po 'bras bu'i theg pa 'dir chud de dbang bskur bas khams gsum gyi rgyal srid chen po sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du zhugs pa dang tshul mtshungs pa yin no// zhes pa'i don to// de nas dbang thob pa'i bslab bya'i gtso bo dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi lag pa nas bzung ste tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ nangs par sngar langs sogs nas kun 'grub 'gyur zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang*/ thun mong ba'i dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba dang*/

khyad par gyi dam tshig ni/ bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa bud med ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ dngos grub stsol ba'i mkha' 'gro ma gang na yod cha med pas/ bud med gang mthong ba la yid kyis phyag dang bskor ba byas la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag gi ma ni khyod yin la// khyod kyi bu ni bdag yin no// ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du// byang chub yan lag nu ma las// byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs// zhes pa ste/ nu ma ni chos kyi 'byung gnas te/ rang gi 'o mas skyongs zhes pa ni bde stong dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas par byin gyis rlobs shig ces pa'i don to// gnyis pa la spyod pa dang mthun par thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig dngos te gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ dam tshig 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ gnyis med ye shes sogs nas ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes pa'i bar te/ de'i don yang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la tshul bzhin du longs spyod par gyis shig pa'i don yin/ gnyis pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig dngos la 'dod chags bral ba sogs nas ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces te/ de'i don yang dad pa chen pos sogs nas/ lhag par byos shig ces pa'i don to// de nas slob dpon gyis khyed rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ shrī badzra sogs lha thams cad kyi snying po'i sngags tshar gcig brjod la/ dpung pa g.yon pa'am g.yas pa la bsrung ba'i gdub bu bcing zhing mgo bor gdugs dkar po bzung zhing dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas mthar/ shar sgo nas gdugs dang bcas pas phyag byas par mos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo bo dud tsam byas te/ rang gi lus bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul bar mos pa mdzod cig sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/

slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags zhes pas phul nas rang rang gi gral la 'khod par mos shig de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing sogs nas skal ba dang ldan par byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de ltar sngar bstan pa'i dbang drug po de dag ni spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyi bum pa'i khyad par 'jug pas na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba zhes bya'o// gsang ba'i dbang la bla ma longs sku'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ rig ma rgyan dang ldan pa zhig phyag rgyar phul ba mos la me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ skyabs med skyob pa nas bdag la skyobs/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ sngon chad bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes pas mig ras bcings/ bsrung ba'i phyir slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing*/ bdud rtsis khyed rnams kyi lus la gtor te bsrungs nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtser lhan cig skyes pa rang rig pa'i ngo bo brtan par byas pa de slob dpon rang gi mthe bong dang srin lag gis blangs te/ khyed rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag ces dang dngos su bdud rtsi byin te/ btung ba rin chen sogs nas 'thungs shig ces brjod la byin pa'i bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ zhes brjod cing myang bar zhu zhes dang*/ yum gyis kyang rang gi chu skyes kyi nang gi bdud rtsi gnang bar bsams la bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs nas sgrub par gyis zhes gsung zhing byin pa de nyid kyang a ho ma hā su khaṃ zhes brjod cing myang bar zhu/ de ltar myangs pas mgrin par gzhir gnas pa'i ya ra la wa zhes pa'i yi ge byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa la/

slob dpon gyis byin pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres pas/ snang mched thob gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rags pa rnams 'gags nas/ stong pa dang shin tu stong pa chen po'i nyams skyes te/ snang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin stong pa gsum ro gcig tu gyur pa gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos la cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na rdzas gsang ba sogs nas skal ba dang ldan par byas snyam du mos pa mdzod ces rtogs pa bskyed/ de ni rdzas gsang ba byang chub kyi sems yin pas des dbang bskur bas na gsang ba'i dbang zhes bya ba yin no// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la bla ma chos kyi sku'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs nas deng bdag stsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar 'bru lngas mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ 'bru gsum gyis sngar bzhin bsrungs la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma yid du 'ong ba lang tsho dar la bab pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig sprul te/ sangs rgyas rnams dpang por byas nas khyed rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par rig ma'i lag pa g.yon pa gtad cing spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ gzungs ma yid 'ong nas dngos grub med/ ces pas byin pa'i phyag rgya des khyed rnams gsang ba'i kun du spyod pa rnams kyi snod dang ldan mi ldan brtag pa'i phyir dri ba byas par mos pa mdzod/ bshang gci sogs nas smros shig ces dris pa la de ltar spro'o zhes lan btab par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/
