bshang gci sogs nas ci phyir bdag mi spro zhes lan btab pas/ phyag rgya des gos dang bral ba'i lus tsandan dang gur gum la sogs pas dri zhim par byas/ me tog gi phreng bas brgyan nas chu skyes gsal bar bstan cing*/ e ma nga yi padma sogs nas ho zhes gsung zhing pang du byon par mos te/ khyed rnams 'khor lo bde mchog dang rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal ba sprul sku lam du byed pa lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi lte ba sogs nas nor bu dmar po byeṃ gyis mtshan pa ste/ yab yum gyi gnas bsnol ma dang mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa longs sku lam du byed pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos sku lam du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs pa bsams la/ oṃ shi shi shi ha ha ha swā hā zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ zhes snyoms par zhugs pas khyed rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum thams cad bkug ste/ khyed rnams kyi lus la thim pas ro gcig tu gyur te/ spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus pa yab yum rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba dbu ma'i lam nas 'khor lo bzhi brgyud de yas bab kyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor chags pa dang chags bral zung du chud pa'i bde stong gi ngang la mnyam par 'jog mdzod cig rdo rje padma sogs nas gyis gnas bya// zhes pa de yas bab kyi dga' ba yin/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bsgrub pa'i slad du/ byang chub kyi sems mkha' gsang gi rtse mor rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyis bzung ba de/ slar yi ge hūm̐ gi gdangs can gyi rlung gis drangs te/ lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ dpral bar byon pas khyad par dga' ba/ gtsug tor du byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba brtan par byas/

de'i tshe byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad la khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas khyab/ de thams cad la mi rtog pas khyab ste/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin skyes par mos pa mdzod/ gang gi tshe shes rab ma mnyes nas khyed rnams kyi mgo bor yum gyi phyag g.yon pa bzhag ste rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la gsan pas khyab ste/ deng nas bzung ste sogs nas gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsams pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar 'bru gsum gyis mig ras 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du sogs nas skal ba dang ldan par byas so zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de ni dngos sam yid kyi shes rab ma la brten nas ye shes dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa bskyed pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhes bya'o// dbang bzhi pa la bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ khyod zhabs sogs nas bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas mig ras bcings la/ bsrung ba sngar bzhin byas la/ de'ang dbang bzhi pa ni khyed rnams kyi dbang gsum pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i dus su/ rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas sems nyid bde ba chen por rig pa'i ye shes des mtshon pa'i/ don gyi ye shes don dam pa byang chub kyi sems de nyid tshig tsam gyi sgo nas ngo sprad pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ yid med yid ni byas nas su// rtog ge'i sbyor ba rnam par spong*// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa la/ khyed rnams lus mnyam gzhag gi spyod lam dang ldan zhing*/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag yid rnam rtog gi spro bsdu'am dus gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs te/ yul gzugs sgra la sogs pa gang la'ang mi 'jug par sngar gyi dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi dpe'i ye shes kyi steng du rtogs par bya ba ni/

rang nyid dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rnam par shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ lha sku bde ba chen po'i rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi sku dang*/ de gsum ldog tshul tha dad kyang rang bzhin so sor dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa/ gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la/ nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ro mnyam pa de bzhin du sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid la sems bde stong ro mnyam pa so sor rang gi rig pa'i ting nge 'dzin nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de dbang bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing mthong sogs nas ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// zhes rtogs bskyed bya'o// de ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes tshig tsam gyi sgo nas ngo sprad pas na tshig gi bzhi pa zhes bya'o// mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la bsrung bsdam tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal sogs lan gsum/ zhes pas dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes nas/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas rang gi lus longs spyod la sogs pa thams cad slob dpon la dbang gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas brtsams te zhes sogs lan gsum bya'o// de ltar na khyed rnams kyis grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon nam ras bris zhes skabs su gang babs la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa gsan pa yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas sogs kyis dge ba bsngos la/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong ngo*// slob dpon gyis rjes kyi cho ga rnams dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ sngon byon dran dbang zhal lung tha dad snying po dag /gcig tu bsdebs la ngag gi dbang phyug mngon gyur pas// brtse chen kun dga'i ring lugs kun gsal blo gros can// gang las byung ba'i bde 'byung cho ga'i yan lag tu// spyi 'gros brjod bde nam mkha'i go la yangs par rgyu// khyad chos ma 'dres gang yin khyim na dgyes dgur spyod// brda sprod rnam gsal ma zlum dkyil 'khor 'di shar tshe// brjod bya rtogs dka'i phyogs kyi ltad mo mi snang med// 'di byas dge bas chos rnams thams cad ston mchog nyid// dgongs gcig 'doms pa sa skya pa yi lung rtogs bstan// de 'dzin rjes su slob par bcas pa'i phrin las rgyun// bskal pa'i pha rol mi mngon de srid dar gyur cig /ces 'khor lo bde mchog grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas mdzad pa'i yan lag tu dgos pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor rnam gsal nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ skyabs mgon mchog gi phrin las kyi kha lo bsgyur ba/ mdo sngags rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bzang po pas rjes 'jug rnams la phan par dgongs pa'i gsung bskul gyis phebs par brten/

bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung me zla'i nang gsal thams cad 'dul zhes pa'i gnam lo'i sgrol byed snron gyis nya ba'i zhag gi phung po'i rgyal ba gnyis par/ lhag pa lag sor gyi 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i nyin grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
